title: NeetCode 150
summary: Original practice versions of the 150 problems on the NeetCode 150 study list: the Blind 75 plus 75 more. A community study plan, not an official or verified question list.
lesson:
About this list
- NeetCode 150 is a widely used community study list that keeps every Blind 75 problem and adds 75 more, so each pattern gets a second or third problem to practice on.
- The additions fill in areas the shorter list touches lightly: stacks, backtracking, advanced graphs such as shortest paths and minimum spanning trees, two-dimensional dynamic programming, greedy choices, and math.
- Every problem here is an original practice version written for this plugin. Titles, statements, examples, and tests are our own, so details can differ from versions you find elsewhere.
- The list is a community study plan, not an official or verified set of questions from any company.

What to expect
- Expect several problems per pattern; the later ones in a group often add one twist, such as duplicates, a constraint on extra space, or a design requirement.
- The Hard problems lean on combining two ideas, for example a heap with a graph search or binary search over the answer with a greedy check.
- Interviewers commonly ask for a brute-force idea first, then an improvement, with the time and space complexity of each.

How to prepare
- If you have finished the Blind 75, filter by a topic and solve only the problems you have not passed yet.
- Solve each group in order of difficulty and write down the shared technique before moving to the next group.
- Time box each attempt; after the limit, open one hint at a time rather than the whole approach.
- Revisit problems you passed after a few days and solve them again from a blank starter.
